page_data.en:
The Systems of Communication in use by the Shanghai Municipal Police
are, in addition to the usual telephone network, Wireless Patrol Vans, a
Street Telephone System and a Burglar Alarm System. Two further methods of
communication are to be installed within the year, viz., a Teleprinter(Teletype)
System and an Anti-Kidnapping Direction Finding Control Station.

The Communication Control Department is at Headquarters and is
housed in specially built quarters on the top of the Administration Building,
being known as the "Communication Control Room." In it are installed the
Main Telephone Switchboard, the Wireless Transmitter and the Street Telephone
Central Switchboard. During the year, there will also be installed in this
room, the Power Apparatus and Control Switchboard of the Teleprinter System
together with three combined sending-receiving Teleprinters and the Plotting
Instruments for Direction Finding. The latter installation will be explained
under Kidnapping Prevention.

1. Wireless.
The Police operate twelve Wireless Receiving Vans controlled by the
Transmitter at Headquarters. The receiving sets in these vans are serviced
by the Communication Control Room and the vans are garaged and cared for by
the Transport Office and are called for by the Stations as and when required.
The Officer detailed for patrol telephones to the Communication Control Room,
reporting his departure and return to the Station. The above procedure, of
course, applies to ordinary routine. The Vans were built locally and are
designed to accomodate ten men equipped with steel waistcoats. The Receivers
are of the Marconi "A5" type, designed and built in Shanghai by the Chinese
National Wireless Telegraph Co., an associate company of the Marconi Wireless
Telegraph Co., of London. The Dials are locked on the Police Wavelength and
the set is equipped with both earphones and loudspeaker. The Transmitter at
Headquarters is a Marconi I.M.B.1A., 100 watt Marine type additionally
equipped with a buzzer circuit. The Buzzer acts as a "Howler" and is used
to precede all emergency calls so that if the patrol is out of the van for
any purpose, the call is sufficiently loud to summon them to receive the
message. Although the Transmitter is equipped with both Microphone and
C.W.Telegraph circuits, only the Microphone is used and a range of approx-
imately 30 miles could be obtained under adverse conditions. Needless to
say, this range has not been tested as the limits of the Settlement preclude
any test of over 10 miles.

2. Street Telephones.
Situated at advantageous points within the Settlement, are 139
Street Telephone Boxes. The points for these telephones were not selected
for best use, as is the case in most cities, but are situated near the
boundary of the Settlement or at boundary gates and upon roads leading into
outside territory likely to be used by criminals in their attempt to escape
and upon all important bridges across Soochow Creek, a congested waterway
leading into the interior. The primary use of these telephones is for
emergencies and they are tested out daily by the Foreign General Duty Officer
on his rounds. Another use of this system, however, might be mentioned,
i.e., their connection with the Wireless Vans. Practically the only
communication a van has with Headquarters during his tour of duty is by this
method. His tests while outside the Station are reported by Street
Telephone and if a call is necessary to a van which might inadvertently be
unable to receive a call, due to a fade out or to a set failing to function
properly he is immediately located by means of the Street Telephone System.
All Street Telephones are connected directly to a separate Switchboard at the
Station in the District in which the Telephone Box is situated and each
Station Switchboard is in turn linked by a trunk line to the Central Control
Switchboard at Headquarters. The Telephones now in use are of the regular
G.P.O. type and are housed in Iron clad type boxes manufactured by the Western
Electric Co. Each Box, in addition to the bell has an intermittent flashing
red lamp on the pole on which the box is mounted or else suspended over or
across the road from that corner. The light is operated by means of a relay
in the ringing circuit, giving it the same impulse as the telephone ringer,
and will not cease flashing until the call is answered. This system is
maintained by the Telephone Company.

上海公共租界工部局警务处使用的通信系统，除常规电话网络外，还包括无线巡逻车、街道电话系统和防盗报警系统。年内还将安装另外两种通信方式，即电传打字机（Teletype）系统和反绑架测向控制站。

通信控制部位于总部，设在行政大楼顶层特建的房间内，称为“通信控制室”。室内安装有主电话交换机、无线发射机和街道电话中央交换机。年内，该室还将安装电传打字机系统的动力装置和控制交换机，以及三台收发合一的电传打字机和用于测向的标绘仪器。后者的安装将在“预防绑架”部分予以说明。

1. 无线通信。
警方运营着十二辆无线接收车，由总部的发射机控制。这些车辆中的接收设备由通信控制室负责维护，车辆由运输科负责停放和保养，各警署根据需要调用。负责巡逻电话联络的警官向通信控制室报告，汇报其离开警署及返回的情况。上述程序当然适用于日常例行工作。这些车辆系本地制造，设计可容纳十名配备钢制防弹背心的警员。接收机为马可尼“A5”型，由伦敦马可尼无线电报公司的关联公司——中国国立无线电报公司在上海设计和制造。刻度盘锁定在警用波长上，设备配有耳机和扬声器。总部的发射机为马可尼 I.M.B.1A 型，100瓦海事型，另配有蜂鸣器电路。蜂鸣器充当“警报器”，用于在所有紧急呼叫之前发出信号，以便如果巡逻人员因任何原因不在车内，呼叫声足够响亮以召唤他们接收信息。虽然发射机配有麦克风和等幅波（C.W.）电报电路，但仅使用麦克风，在不利条件下可获得约30英里的范围。毋庸赘言，这一范围未经测试，因为租界的界限排除了任何超过10英里的测试可能。

2. 街道电话。
在租界内的有利位置设有139个街道电话亭。这些电话的位置并非像大多数城市那样为了最佳使用效果而选择，而是位于租界边界附近或边界关卡处，以及通往外部领土的道路上，罪犯在试图逃跑时可能会利用这些道路；此外还设在跨越苏州河的所有重要桥梁上，苏州河是一条通往内地的拥挤水道。这些电话的主要用途是应对紧急情况，由外籍总巡官在日常巡视中每天进行测试。不过，该系统的另一个用途值得一提，即其与无线巡逻车的连接。巡逻车在执勤期间与总部的联系实际上几乎仅通过此方法进行。其在警署外的测试情况通过街道电话报告，如果需要呼叫一辆可能因信号衰减或设备故障而无法意外接收呼叫的巡逻车，则可通过街道电话系统立即定位该车。所有街道电话直接连接到电话亭所在辖区警署的独立交换机，每个警署交换机又通过中继线连接到总部的中央控制交换机。目前使用的电话为常规的邮政总局（G.P.O.）类型，安置在西屋电气公司制造的铁壳箱内。每个箱子除了铃铛外，在安装箱子的杆子上，或者悬挂在该角落上方或横跨道路的杆子上，还有一个间歇闪烁的红灯。该灯通过振铃电路中的继电器操作，使其获得与电话铃声相同的脉冲，并且在呼叫被接听之前不会停止闪烁。该系统由电话公司维护。

- 2 -

3. Burglar Alarms.
A Burglar Alarm System is maintained and operated by the Telephone Company. It connects the principal banks, jewellery stores, mills, etc., to the nearest Station by means of a disc contact at the subscriber's end to a punch-tape receiving apparatus at the Station. As soon as the disc has been dislocated, the contact starts a sending apparatus which gives the necessary impulses to the receiver to punch the tape for the number assigned to that subscriber. This apparatus does not come under the control of the Communication Control Department as direct communication is a speedier method of handling calls of this nature.

4. Teleprinters.
This branch of communication is to be installed during the year and will be of the Creed page type. There will be a combined receiving and sending machine at each Station and three like machines at Headquarters. This system will be "phantomed" over the Street Telephone Trunk Lines. Teleprinter operation is well known to nearly every Police Force in the world and therefore requires no detailed description of construction or operation.

5. Kidnapping Prevention.
Kidnapping is probably more prevalent in China and Shanghai in particular, than any place in the world. This fact has led to the formation of a company to assist in preventing such crimes. This company has been favorably considered by the Shanghai Municipal Police and is to install its apparatus in the Police Stations most advantageously situated. The apparatus will be installed and maintained by the company but manned and operated by the Police Department. The Communication Control Room will have the main Plotting Apparatus and direct by wireless the pursuit and interception of Motor Car Kidnappers. Wireless will be used. A Transmitter will be installed on Motor Cars of those who subscribe to this system of crime prevention. The Transmitter starts operating at the will of the person upon whom an attempted Kidnapping is being made by means of a privately known contact and cannot be shut off. This call is picked up by the Direction Finding Stations mentioned above and the readings of these Stations communicated by direct line to the Control Room where, with a similar instrument, the exact location of the Car will be plotted, and followed. In the meantime Police Wireless Vans will have been directed to the route taken and other necessary details such as the person's name and description and the details of the Motor Car used.

APR. 17 1932

3. 防盗报警器。
防盗报警系统由电话公司维护和运营。它通过用户端的圆盘触点连接到警署的穿孔带接收装置，将主要银行、珠宝店、工厂等与最近的警署连接起来。一旦圆盘被移位，触点就会启动发送装置，向接收器发出必要的脉冲，在纸带上打出分配给该用户的号码。该装置不属于通信控制部的管辖范围，因为直接通信是处理此类呼叫更快捷的方法。

4. 电传打字机。
这一通信分支将于年内安装，采用克里德（Creed）页式类型。每个警署将配备一台收发合一的机器，总部将配备三台类似的机器。该系统将通过街道电话中继线进行“幻象”传输（phantomed）。电传打字机的操作为世界几乎所有警察部队所熟知，因此无需对其结构或操作进行详细描述。

5. 预防绑架。
绑架案在中国，尤其是上海，可能比世界上任何地方都更为普遍。这一事实促使成立了一家公司来协助预防此类犯罪。该公司已得到上海公共租界工部局警务处的积极考虑，并将在位置最有利的警署安装其设备。设备将由该公司安装和维护，但由警务处人员操作和管理。通信控制室将拥有主要的标绘设备，并通过无线电信号直接指挥对汽车绑架犯的追捕和拦截。将使用无线通信。订阅此犯罪预防系统的人士的汽车上将安装发射机。当有人试图绑架某人时，该人可通过一个私下知晓的触点随意启动发射机，且无法关闭。上述测向站会接收到该呼叫，并将这些站的读数通过专线传送到控制室，在那里使用类似的仪器标绘并跟踪汽车的确切位置。与此同时，无线巡逻车将被引导至所采取的路线，并获取其他必要细节，如当事人的姓名和体貌特征以及所用汽车的细节。

1932年4月17日

UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA
Bureau of Public Administration
Berkeley

December 28, 1931

Edwin S. Cunningham,
Consul General,
American Consulate,
Shanghai, China.

My dear Mr. Cunningham:

A manual of police communication systems is now in preparation by the Department of Police, Berkeley, California, in conjunction with the University of California, -- one of a series of textbooks to be published shortly covering the field of Police Administration.

It is our desire to include in the present volume a study of foreign police communication methods. May I therefore ask your assistance in obtaining from local police executives a few brief points of information concerning their methods and equipment.

For our purposes a consideration of the local police communication set-up as it presents itself to you would be sufficient. This would include only a description of visual or audible signal equipment operated from headquarters for communicating with patrol officers in emergencies and police box telephone plan for return call by the officers.

Information concerning police radio communication system, if employed, would be of unusual interest, as would bank and burglar alarm devices which inform police headquarters of the presence of criminals. Photographs of equipment, where obtainable, would be of great value.

In all probability, police executives in your vicinity are familiar with articles, papers, or studies which have already been written on one phase or another of the general subject of police communications. If it is at all possible to obtain for us copies of this material (translation not necessary), we should be extremely grateful to you.

Literature on this subject is very rare in the United States and your cooperation is sincerely invited in our endeavor to present to the police field an authentic text-book on the police communication problem.

Assuring you that your courtesy and assistance in this work will be appreciated, and with the hope that you will call upon me whenever I can be of service, I am

Copied by HW                  Very truly yours,
Compared with JEB             (Signed) August Vollmer
                              Professor in Police Administration.

埃德温·S·坎宁安，
总领事，
美国领事馆，
中国上海。

亲爱的坎宁安先生：

加利福尼亚州伯克利警察局正与加州大学合作编制一本警务通信系统手册，这是即将出版的一系列涵盖警务管理领域的教科书之一。

我们希望在当前卷册中包含一项关于外国警察通信方法的研究。因此，能否请您协助从当地警务主管那里获取一些关于其方法和设备的简要信息点。

出于我们的目的，仅需考虑向您呈现的当地警察通信设置即可。这仅包括描述从总部操作用于在紧急情况下与巡逻警官通信的视觉或听觉信号设备，以及供警官回呼的警亭电话计划。

有关警察无线电通信系统（如果使用）的信息将具有非凡的兴趣，同样令人感兴趣的是那些向警察总部通报罪犯存在的银行和防盗报警装置。如有可能，设备的照片将具有极大价值。

很可能，您附近的警务主管熟悉已经写成的关于警务通信一般主题的一个或多个方面的文章、论文或研究。如果有可能为我们获取这些材料的副本（无需翻译），我们将对您感激不尽。

在美国，关于这一主题的文献非常罕见，我们真诚邀请您合作，帮助我们向警务领域提供一本关于警察通信问题的权威教科书。

相信您在此项工作中的礼貌和帮助将受到赞赏，并希望在我能为您提供服务时随时联系我，我是

HW 抄录                  您真诚的，
与 JEB 核对             （签名）奥古斯特·沃尔默
                              警务管理教授。
